points.text: And you're not "worse" — agentic AI is no longer a single-tool field, there are open alternatives.

For example: Claude Code → LiteLLM → Cerebras gpt-oss-120b — Claude Code UI with an open model Aider → direct OpenRouter → DeepSeek-Coder — classic OSS workflow Hermes → LiteLLM with fallback array — SOVERN pattern
This module teaches you to think about the whole stack rather than "knowing one tool".

points: You can use stacks like Claude Code with LiteLLM and Cerebras gpt-oss-120b or Claude Code UI with Aider, OpenRouter, and DeepSeek-Coder.
Other options include the classic Hermes workflow with LiteLLM and a fallback array or the SOVERN pattern.
This module teaches you to think about the whole stack rather than knowing one tool.
